long_biography.plain_text:
Salerno studied law at Bond University before turning to beauty retail. In 2012 he and Nikki Eslami founded Bellami Hair in California, combining premium hair extensions with an e-commerce model and celebrity-led social marketing. They grew the brand without outside funding or debt before accepting expansion capital, adding physical beauty bars and a professional channel for stylists.

Beauty Industry Group acquired Bellami in 2022, bringing it into a larger portfolio of hair-extension brands. Salerno stayed on as chief executive after the transaction, focusing on broader customer reach and stylist education. The integrated business sold through consumer e-commerce, professional distribution and company-operated salons.
